S79 Skyline Dining
May 2023 • Couples
I was introduced to a restaurant by a friend at the tallest building in Southeast Asia.
Guess what ? Southeast Asia's 2nd tallest restaurant on the 79th floor at Landmark 81.
I had dinner here. S79 Skyline Dining.
With the 9-course menu, I'm really impressed with the food here. Especially Ox Tongues, the service here is very dedicated and fun.
I recommend you guys go into the sunset, the afternoon is very nice and book a table in advance.
